column2:
pack(n./v.)包、一包、打包、裝箱
packing(n.)打包、包裝
packed(adj.)擠滿的
pack a suitcase 收拾行李箱
a pack of cards 一副撲克牌
I need to pack my bag tonight.
(我今晚需要收拾我的包包。)
He bought a pack of gum at the store.
(他在商店買了一包口香糖。)

package(n.)包裹、套裝
pack(v.)打包
packaging(n.)包裝材料
receive a package 收到包裹
package tour 套裝旅遊
A package came for you this morning.
(今天早上有你的一個包裹寄來。)
We went to Japan on a package tour.
(我們參加套裝旅遊去日本。)

page(n.)頁、頁面
(無詞性變化)
turn the page 翻頁
front page 頭版
Please turn to page ten.
(請翻到第十頁。)
His picture was on the front page.
(他的照片登上了頭版。)

paint(n./v.)油漆、顏料、畫、粉刷
painter(n.)畫家、油漆工
painting(n.)畫作
paint a picture 畫一幅畫
wet paint 油漆未乾
We will paint the wall blue.
(我們要把牆漆成藍色。)
Don't touch the door. The paint is still wet.
(別碰門，油漆還沒乾。)

pair(n.)一雙、一對
(無詞性變化)
a pair of shoes 一雙鞋
in pairs 兩人一組
I bought a new pair of shoes.
(我買了一雙新鞋。)
Please work in pairs for this activity.
(這個活動請兩人一組進行。)

pants(n.)褲子
(無詞性變化)
a pair of pants 一條褲子
long pants 長褲
These pants are too long for me.
(這條褲子對我來說太長了。)
He wore black pants to the party.
(他穿黑色褲子去參加派對。)

paper(n./v.)紙、報紙、報告、貼壁紙
(無詞性變化)
a piece of paper 一張紙
write a paper 寫報告
Can I have a piece of paper?
(可以給我一張紙嗎？)
My dad reads the paper every morning.
(我爸爸每天早上看報紙。)

parent(n.)父親或母親、parents(n.)雙親、父母
parental(adj.)父母的
single parent 單親
parents' meeting 家長會
My parents both work in Taipei.
(我的父母都在台北工作。)
She is a single parent with two kids.
(她是帶著兩個孩子的單親家長。)

park(n./v.)公園、停車
parking(n.)停車
park a car 停車
parking lot 停車場
We had a picnic in the park.
(我們在公園野餐。)
You can't park your car here.
(你不能把車停在這裡。)

part(n./v.)部分、角色、分開
partly(adv.)部分地
partial(adj.)部分的
take part in 參加
part of 一部分
Part of the cake is gone.
(蛋糕有一部分不見了。)
Many students took part in the game.
(許多學生參加了比賽。)

party(n./v.)派對、政黨、開派對
(無詞性變化)
birthday party 生日派對
have a party 舉辦派對
We had a party for Mom's birthday.
(我們為媽媽的生日辦了派對。)
Are you coming to my party tonight?
(你今晚會來我的派對嗎？)

pass(v./n.)經過、通過、傳遞、通行證
passage(n.)通道、段落
passer-by(n.)路人
pass the test 通過考試
pass the salt 把鹽遞過來
Could you pass me the salt, please?
(可以請你把鹽遞給我嗎？)
She studied hard and passed the test.
(她努力讀書，通過了考試。)

past(adj./n./prep./adv.)過去的、過去、經過、超過
(無詞性變化)
in the past 在過去
half past six 六點半
It's half past six now.
(現在是六點半。)
We walked past the old school.
(我們走過那間舊學校。)

pay(v.)付錢、支付、payment(n.)付款
paid(adj.)有薪的
pay for 為…付錢
pay attention to 注意
I will pay for lunch today.
(今天午餐我來付錢。)
Please pay attention to the teacher.
(請注意聽老師講。)

pen(n./v.)筆、原子筆、寫
(無詞性變化)
pen pal 筆友
a red pen 一支紅筆
May I borrow your pen?
(我可以借你的筆嗎？)
I have a pen pal in Canada.
(我在加拿大有一個筆友。)

pencil(n.)鉛筆
(無詞性變化)
pencil case 鉛筆盒
sharpen a pencil 削鉛筆
Please write your name in pencil.
(請用鉛筆寫下你的名字。)
My pencil case is on the desk.
(我的鉛筆盒在桌上。)

people(n./v.)人們、民族、居住於
(無詞性變化)
young people 年輕人
many people 許多人
Many people like this song.
(許多人喜歡這首歌。)
There were ten people in the room.
(房間裡有十個人。)

perhaps(adv.)或許、可能
(無詞性變化)
perhaps not 或許不
perhaps tomorrow 也許明天
Perhaps it will rain this afternoon.
(今天下午或許會下雨。)
Perhaps you are right about that.
(關於那件事，也許你是對的。)

person(n.)人、個人
personal(adj.)個人的
in person 親自
a kind person 一個好心的人
She is a very kind person.
(她是一個非常善良的人。)
I want to thank him in person.
(我想親自向他道謝。)

pet(n./v.)寵物、撫摸
(無詞性變化)
pet dog 寵物狗
pet shop 寵物店
Do you have any pets at home?
(你家裡有養寵物嗎？)
The boy gently petted the cat.
(那個男孩輕輕撫摸那隻貓。)

photograph(n./v.)照片、拍照
photo(n.)照片(口語)
photographer(n.)攝影師
photography(n.)攝影
take a photo 拍照
family photo 全家福
Let's take a photo together.
(我們一起拍張照吧。)
This is an old photo of my family.
(這是我家人的一張舊照片。)

piano(n.)鋼琴
pianist(n.)鋼琴家
play the piano 彈鋼琴
piano lesson 鋼琴課
My sister can play the piano well.
(我妹妹鋼琴彈得很好。)
I have a piano lesson on Friday.
(我星期五有鋼琴課。)

pick(v./n.)挑選、摘、選擇
(無詞性變化)
pick up 撿起、接(人)
pick out 挑出
Please pick up the trash on the floor.
(請把地上的垃圾撿起來。)
My mom will pick me up at five.
(我媽媽五點會來接我。)

picnic(n./v.)野餐、去野餐
(無詞性變化)
have a picnic 野餐
picnic basket 野餐籃
Let's have a picnic by the river.
(我們去河邊野餐吧。)
She packed sandwiches in the picnic basket.
(她把三明治裝進野餐籃。)

picture(n./v.)圖畫、照片、想像
(無詞性變化)
take a picture 拍照
draw a picture 畫畫
Can you take a picture of us?
(你可以幫我們拍張照嗎？)
The little girl drew a picture of her dog.
(那個小女孩畫了她的狗。)

pie(n.)派、餡餅
(無詞性變化)
apple pie 蘋果派
a piece of pie 一塊派
Grandma made an apple pie for us.
(奶奶為我們做了蘋果派。)
Would you like a piece of pie?
(你想來一塊派嗎？)

piece(n./v.)一片、一塊、一件、拼湊
(無詞性變化)
a piece of cake 一塊蛋糕、小事一樁
in pieces 成碎片
Can I have another piece of cake?
(我可以再吃一塊蛋糕嗎？)
The glass fell and broke into pieces.
(玻璃杯掉下去摔成碎片。)

pig(n./v.)豬、狼吞虎嚥
piggy(n.)小豬
pig out 大吃大喝
piggy bank 小豬撲滿
The farmer has five pigs.
(那個農夫養了五頭豬。)
We pigged out on pizza last night.
(我們昨晚大吃披薩。)

pin(n./v.)別針、大頭針、釘住
(無詞性變化)
safety pin 安全別針
pin up 釘起來
She used a pin to fix her dress.
(她用別針固定她的洋裝。)
He pinned the notice on the board.
(他把公告釘在布告欄上。)

pink(adj./n.)粉紅色的、粉紅色
(無詞性變化)
pink dress 粉紅色洋裝
light pink 淺粉紅色
She is wearing a pink dress.
(她穿著一件粉紅色洋裝。)
Pink is my favorite color.
(粉紅色是我最喜歡的顏色。)

pipe(n./v.)管子、煙斗、用管輸送
pipeline(n.)管線
water pipe 水管
smoke a pipe 抽煙斗
The water pipe under the sink is broken.
(水槽下面的水管破了。)
My grandpa used to smoke a pipe.
(我爺爺以前會抽煙斗。)

place(n./v.)地方、位置、放置
(無詞性變化)
take place 發生、舉行
in place of 代替
This is a nice place to live.
(這是一個適合居住的好地方。)
The meeting will take place on Monday.
(會議將在星期一舉行。)

plan(n./v.)計畫、打算
planner(n.)規劃者
make a plan 訂計畫
plan to 打算
What are your plans for the weekend?
(你週末有什麼計畫？)
We plan to visit Tainan next month.
(我們打算下個月去台南。)

planet(n.)行星
planetary(adj.)行星的
planet Earth 地球
another planet 另一個星球
Earth is the planet we live on.
(地球是我們居住的行星。)
Mars is a red planet.
(火星是一顆紅色的行星。)

plant(n./v.)植物、工廠、種植
planter(n.)花盆
plant trees 種樹
power plant 發電廠
We plant trees every spring.
(我們每年春天種樹。)
Water the plants every morning.
(每天早上替植物澆水。)

plate(n.)盤子、一盤
(無詞性變化)
a plate of rice 一盤飯
clean plate 吃光盤中的食物
Put the cake on a plate.
(把蛋糕放在盤子上。)
He ate a whole plate of noodles.
(他吃了一整盤麵。)

play(v./n.)玩、演奏、比賽、戲劇
player(n.)球員、玩家
playful(adj.)愛玩的
play basketball 打籃球
play the guitar 彈吉他
The kids play in the park every day.
(孩子們每天在公園裡玩。)
We went to see a play last night.
(我們昨晚去看了一齣戲。)

player(n.)選手、球員、演奏者、播放器
play(v.)玩、比賽
basketball player 籃球員
team player 有團隊精神的人
He is the best player on our team.
(他是我們隊上最好的選手。)
She is a famous piano player.
(她是一位有名的鋼琴演奏者。)

please(v.)使高興、請
pleased(adj.)高興的
pleasant(adj.)令人愉快的
please sit down 請坐
be pleased with 對…滿意
Please close the door.
(請把門關上。)
It is hard to please my boss.
(要讓我的老闆滿意很難。)

pleasure(n.)樂趣、愉快、榮幸
pleasant(adj.)令人愉快的
with pleasure 樂意
my pleasure 不客氣、我的榮幸
Reading gives me a lot of pleasure.
(閱讀帶給我很多樂趣。)
'Thank you for your help.' 'My pleasure.'
(「謝謝你的幫忙。」「不客氣。」)

pm(adv.)下午、午後(亦寫作 p.m.)
(無詞性變化)
at 3 pm 下午三點
from 2 to 5 pm 下午兩點到五點
The movie starts at 7 pm.
(電影晚上七點開始。)
The store closes at 9 p.m.
(這家店晚上九點關門。)

pocket(n./v.)口袋、放入口袋
pocketful(n.)一袋之量
pocket money 零用錢
in my pocket 在我的口袋裡
I put my phone in my pocket.
(我把手機放進口袋。)
How much pocket money do you get?
(你拿多少零用錢？)

point(n./v.)點、要點、分數、指
pointed(adj.)尖的
point at 指著
point of view 觀點
It's rude to point at people.
(用手指著別人是不禮貌的。)
Our team won by two points.
(我們隊以兩分之差獲勝。)

police(n./v.)警察、警方、維持治安
policeman(n.)警察
call the police 報警
police station 警察局
We should call the police right now.
(我們應該馬上報警。)
The police station is near my school.
(警察局在我學校附近。)

polite(adj.)有禮貌的
politely(adv.)有禮貌地
politeness(n.)禮貌
be polite to 對…有禮貌
polite answer 有禮貌的回答
You should be polite to older people.
(你應該對長輩有禮貌。)
She answered the question politely.
(她有禮貌地回答了問題。)

pond(n.)池塘
(無詞性變化)
fish pond 魚池
duck pond 鴨池
There are many fish in the pond.
(池塘裡有很多魚。)
The kids fed the ducks by the pond.
(孩子們在池塘邊餵鴨子。)

pool(n./v.)水池、游泳池、共同出資
(無詞性變化)
swimming pool 游泳池
car pool 共乘
We swim in the pool every Sunday.
(我們每個星期天在游泳池游泳。)
The hotel has a big swimming pool.
(那家飯店有一座大型游泳池。)

poor(adj.)貧窮的、可憐的、差的
poverty(n.)貧窮
poorly(adv.)差勁地
poor family 貧窮的家庭
poor health 健康不佳
He grew up in a poor family.
(他在一個貧窮的家庭長大。)
The poor dog was cold and hungry.
(那隻可憐的狗又冷又餓。)

popcorn(n.)爆米花
(無詞性變化)
eat popcorn 吃爆米花
a bag of popcorn 一包爆米花
We ate popcorn at the movies.
(我們在看電影時吃爆米花。)
I bought a big bag of popcorn.
(我買了一大包爆米花。)

popular(adj.)受歡迎的、流行的
popularity(n.)受歡迎、流行
be popular with 受…歡迎
popular music 流行音樂
This game is popular with kids.
(這個遊戲很受小孩歡迎。)
She is the most popular girl in class.
(她是班上最受歡迎的女生。)

possible(adj.)可能的
possibly(adv.)可能地
possibility(n.)可能性
as soon as possible 盡快
if possible 如果可能的話
Please call me back as soon as possible.
(請盡快回電給我。)
Is it possible to finish it today?
(今天有可能完成嗎？)

pot(n./v.)鍋、壺、盆、種在盆裡
(無詞性變化)
a pot of tea 一壺茶
hot pot 火鍋
Let's have hot pot tonight.
(我們今晚吃火鍋吧。)
She made a pot of tea for us.
(她為我們泡了一壺茶。)

potato(n.)馬鈴薯
(無詞性變化)
sweet potato 地瓜
mashed potatoes 馬鈴薯泥
I like sweet potatoes very much.
(我非常喜歡地瓜。)
Mom made potato soup for dinner.
(媽媽晚餐做了馬鈴薯湯。)

power(n./v.)力量、權力、電力、提供動力
powerful(adj.)強大的
in power 掌權
power failure 停電
The storm caused a power failure.
(暴風雨造成了停電。)
Knowledge is power.
(知識就是力量。)

practice(n./v.)練習、實踐
practical(adj.)實用的
practice English 練習英文
in practice 實際上
Practice makes perfect.
(熟能生巧。)
I practice the piano every day.
(我每天練習鋼琴。)

prepare(v.)準備
preparation(n.)準備
prepared(adj.)準備好的
prepare for 為…做準備
prepare dinner 準備晚餐
We are preparing for the final exam.
(我們正在準備期末考。)
Dad is preparing dinner in the kitchen.
(爸爸正在廚房準備晚餐。)

present(adj./n./v.)出席的、現在的、禮物、贈送、呈現
presence(n.)出席
presentation(n.)報告、簡報
birthday present 生日禮物
at present 目前
Thank you for the birthday present.
(謝謝你的生日禮物。)
All the students were present today.
(今天所有學生都出席了。)

pretty(adv./adj.)相當、漂亮的
(無詞性變化)
pretty good 相當好
pretty girl 漂亮的女孩
The test was pretty easy.
(這次考試相當簡單。)
What a pretty dress!
(多漂亮的洋裝啊！)

price(n./v.)價格、定價
priceless(adj.)無價的
high price 高價
price tag 價格標籤
The price of this bag is too high.
(這個包包的價格太高了。)
Look at the price tag first.
(先看一下價格標籤。)

probably(adv.)大概、很可能
probable(adj.)很可能的
probably not 大概不會
will probably 很可能會
It will probably rain tomorrow.
(明天很可能會下雨。)
He is probably at home now.
(他現在大概在家。)

problem(n.)問題
(無詞性變化)
solve a problem 解決問題
no problem 沒問題
Can you help me solve this problem?
(你可以幫我解決這個問題嗎？)
'Can you help me?' 'No problem.'
(「你可以幫我嗎？」「沒問題。」)

program(n./v.)節目、計畫、程式、設計程式
programmer(n.)程式設計師
programming(n.)程式設計
TV program 電視節目
computer program 電腦程式
My favorite TV program starts at eight.
(我最喜歡的電視節目八點開始。)
He wrote a computer program for the game.
(他為這個遊戲寫了一個電腦程式。)

proud(adj.)驕傲的、自豪的
pride(n.)自豪、驕傲
proudly(adv.)驕傲地
be proud of 以…為榮
proud parents 引以為傲的父母
My parents are proud of me.
(我的父母以我為榮。)
She proudly showed us her prize.
(她驕傲地向我們展示她的獎品。)

public(adj./n.)公共的、公開的、大眾
publicly(adv.)公開地
in public 公開地、在公共場合
public library 公立圖書館
Don't shout in public.
(不要在公共場合大叫。)
I often study at the public library.
(我常在公立圖書館讀書。)

pull(v./n.)拉、拖、拉力
(無詞性變化)
pull out 拔出、退出
pull up 停車
Pull the door to open it.
(把門拉開。)
The dentist pulled out my bad tooth.
(牙醫把我的蛀牙拔掉了。)

push(v./n.)推、按、催促
pushy(adj.)強勢的、愛逼人的
push the button 按按鈕
push open 推開
Push the button to start the machine.
(按下按鈕啟動機器。)
He pushed open the heavy door.
(他推開了那扇沉重的門。)

put(v.)放、擺
(無詞性變化)
put on 穿上
put away 收起來
Put your books on the desk.
(把你的書放在桌上。)
Put on your coat. It's cold outside.
(穿上外套，外面很冷。)

quarter(n.)四分之一、一刻鐘、季、二十五分錢
quarterly(adj.)每季的
a quarter past six 六點十五分
a quarter of 四分之一的
It's a quarter past seven.
(現在是七點十五分。)
A quarter of the students walk to school.
(四分之一的學生走路上學。)

queen(n.)女王、皇后
(無詞性變化)
the Queen of England 英國女王
beauty queen 選美冠軍
The queen lived in a big castle.
(女王住在一座大城堡裡。)
She played the queen in the school play.
(她在學校話劇中演女王。)

question(n./v.)問題、詢問、質疑
questionable(adj.)可疑的
ask a question 問問題
answer the question 回答問題
May I ask you a question?
(我可以問你一個問題嗎？)
Please answer the questions in English.
(請用英文回答這些問題。)

quick(adj./adv.)快的、迅速地
quickly(adv.)快速地
quick lunch 簡便的午餐
be quick 快一點
Be quick, or we'll miss the bus.
(快一點，不然我們會錯過公車。)
She gave a quick answer.
(她很快地回答了。)

quiet(adj./n./v.)安靜的、寧靜、使安靜
quietly(adv.)安靜地
keep quiet 保持安靜
quiet place 安靜的地方
Please keep quiet in the library.
(在圖書館裡請保持安靜。)
She walked quietly into the room.
(她安靜地走進房間。)

quite(adv.)相當、十分、完全
(無詞性變化)
quite a few 相當多
not quite 不完全
The movie was quite good.
(那部電影相當好看。)
Quite a few people came to the party.
(相當多人來參加派對。)
